notes.title: ☪️ TSUNDERE MILFIN — Update 1.15 is live!
notes.content:
https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2307220/extras/450hader.gif
🆕 Update 1.15 is now available in-game!

A fresh update has just been released for our beloved office sim — check it out now! 

Version 1.15 adds a brand new situation on the map that brings even more intrigue to your workdays. You’ll also find 2 fully animated scenes and 1 minigame waiting for you. 🔥 ːfuhrer_heartː

To access the new content, you’ll need the Strange Coin. 🪙
What happens if you use it? Who knows… but HR is already watching. 😳

notes.title: FREE UPDATE!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149335/7ea99bd931b33a929c48b6c6595662ed2969a64c.png

ːsteamhappyː Hello kittens ːsteamhappyː,

Many thanks for your feedback and bugreports! We are glad that we have such a friendly community! :3

UPDATE for NALOGI HERE! We fixed many bugs, balanced the combat system, improved the optimization and redesigned UI.

In addition, now a new mod ARENA. It will be interesting to those who have already passed the game. This update is completely free and available to all players now.

Also, if you want to support us, PENSIYA DLC released, this includes a new winter location, a story quest and two new characters from other games of this franchise.

♥Thank you for staying with us! ♥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/971910/NALOGI__PENSIYA_Pack/
